subject: Important Update: Schedule Changes for Next Week
body: Dear team members, Due to unforeseen circumstances, there have been some schedule changes for next week. Please review the updated schedule attached to this email and make note of any changes to your shift timings. We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause and appreciate your understanding. If you have any questions or concerns, feel free to reach out to your supervisor. Thank you for your cooperation. Best regards, [Your Name]
